fatal_findings.claim: The traction inverter control board is functionally empty: 0 of 6 gate-drive channels, 0 of 6 desat channels, 0 of 3 phase-current senses, 0 resolver channels, 0 vehicle CAN, 0 of 3 LV buck rails, 0 HV/LV isolation barriers implemented.
fatal_findings.evidence: pcb.implemented_channel_counts all zero vs required_channel_counts; fitness_fail_reason lists missing roles motor_power_terminals, mcu_cold_plate, oem_inverter_control_board and four '_word' placeholder components with 'no verified implementation'. design_fitness_ok=false while pipeline_ok=true — hygiene passed, engineering absent.
fatal_findings.fix: Implement all seven required channel roles with named MPNs (isolated gate driver, desat detect, shunt/Hall current sense, resolver interface, CAN FD transceiver, LV rails, creepage/cleared isolation barrier), re-run fitness gate to design_fitness_ok=true, then populate and HIL.
fatal_findings.source_rule_hint: pcb-stage.json sha256 59cf4c3c...; RACE-HIL; RACE-SUPPLIER-GERBERS; open_until keys mpn_selection, resolver_mpn, sensor_mpn, channel_implementation

fatal_findings.claim: As modelled, the cold plate thermally kills the inverter: source-to-inlet delta of 112.5 K nominal with an uncertainty band of 73.1–174.4 K. At any realistic FE coolant inlet (50–65 °C) the nominal case puts SiC junction at ~162–177 °C and the upper bound at ~224–239 °C, beyond any 175 °C-class module. Either the model is wrong or the hardware fails; both possibilities are disqualifying for reliance.
fatal_findings.evidence: analytical_physics.cold_plate: heat_load_w=4318, pressure_drop_pa=28501.9, source_to_inlet_delta_k=112.5, uncertainty [73.12,174.37], provenance ANALYTICAL_FROM_ASSUMED_GEOMETRY, measured=false; open_until includes CFD_cold_plate, pressure_drop_bench, supplier_module_Rth. No coolant flow rate or inlet temperature is stated anywhere in the digest.
fatal_findings.fix: Obtain supplier module Rth datasheet, run cold-plate CFD, correlate on flow bench with stated flow rate and inlet temperature, redesign plate until worst-case Tj at max coolant inlet holds margin to module rating; keep analytical tagged UNVALIDATED until correlated.
fatal_findings.source_rule_hint: RACE-CFD-COLD-PLATE (cfd_report_hash, closure_authority cfd_plus_bench); open_until supplier_module_Rth, supplier_module_datasheet, flow_bench, FIA_port_xyz

fatal_findings.claim: The electrical topology is incomplete: LV_POWER, CAN_FD, TEMP_WINDING_W and TEMP_INVERTER are unrouted. As delivered there is no low-voltage supply path to the controller, no vehicle comms, and no winding or inverter temperature telemetry — the unit cannot be powered, controlled, or protected.
fatal_findings.evidence: topology.routed_count=13 of required_count=17; unrouted_edges explicitly [LV_POWER, CAN_FD, TEMP_WINDING_W, TEMP_INVERTER]; race_status OPEN.
fatal_findings.fix: Route all four remaining edges with connector pinouts and wire sizing, freeze the bay-relative ICD, regenerate topology_routed_report.
fatal_findings.source_rule_hint: RACE-TOPOLOGY-COMPLETE (closure_authority SOURCE_topology_proveCatch); open_until connector_ICD, vehicle_hvil_ICD, pierce_seal_ICD

fatal_findings.claim: There is no validated electromagnetic design. EM FEA, core-loss FEA, demag map and even the magnet grade are all open. Torque, field-weakening envelope and high-temperature demag margin of the IPMSM are unverifiable; every performance number downstream of the machine is assumption.
fatal_findings.evidence: open_until includes FEA_em, FEA_core_loss, demag_map, supplier_magnet_grade, hairpin_tooling, impregnation_validation, insulation_system_cert. No EM artefact of any kind appears in source_hashes.
fatal_findings.fix: Place lamination and magnet grade POs, run coupled EM FEA, produce demag map versus temperature at worst-case magnet grade tolerance, validate field-weakening current trajectory, feed core-loss results into the efficiency map.
fatal_findings.source_rule_hint: open_until FEA_em, FEA_core_loss, demag_map, supplier_magnet_grade, lamination_grade_PO; RACE-DYNO blocks DEC-001/DEC-010

fatal_findings.claim: A high-speed IPMSM rotor is offered with no burst FEA, no retention-sleeve FEA, no magnet-retention validation (DEC-006 open) and no balance validation. This is a containment-safety stop: magnet liberation at speed is a lethal failure mode and nothing in the pack addresses it.
fatal_findings.evidence: open_until includes rotor_burst_FEA, retention_sleeve_FEA, DEC-006_magnet_retention, rotor_balance, balance_validation, shaft_fatigue, strength_check.
fatal_findings.fix: Run rotor burst and sleeve FEA at max overspeed with temperature-dependent magnet and sleeve properties, spin-pit test to overspeed with containment, balance to grade per ISO 21940, then close DEC-006 with test evidence.
fatal_findings.source_rule_hint: open_until DEC-006_magnet_retention, rotor_burst_FEA, retention_sleeve_FEA; RACE-DYNO blocks DEC-006

fatal_findings.claim: No FIA technical regulations are held in the twin (regs_on_disk=false, status UNVERIFIED) and no sealed FIA/team interface coordinates exist (RACE-FIA-PORT-XYZ OPEN). Every packaging, mounting and compliance-adjacent statement in the pack is dimensionally unanchored and contractually unusable.
fatal_findings.evidence: regulatory.regs_on_disk=false; forbid_claims includes Gen3_compliant and FIA_homologated; evidence_trail race RACE-FIA-PORT-XYZ OPEN requiring interface_icd_xyz with closure_authority FIA_or_team_ICD; open_until FIA_homologation, FIA_port_xyz.
fatal_findings.fix: Obtain the FIA/team ICD with sealed port coordinates in millimetres, place the current FIA Formula E technical regulations PDF in the twin, re-baseline all interfaces to the ICD, and keep compliance language forbidden until homologation evidence exists.
fatal_findings.source_rule_hint: RACE-FIA-PORT-XYZ; regulatory.forbid_claims; open_until FIA_port_xyz, FIA_homologation, halfshaft_spline_ICD, spline_ICD

fatal_findings.claim: The two load-bearing analytical results (bus ESL 6.39 nH, cold-plate thermal) are computed from 'assumed geometry', and the mesh audit shows the corresponding parts — SiC inverter stack, DC-link bus bar, HV connector, pack housing — are plain cuboids. The analytical layer is derived from placeholder boxes; the numbers are not tied to any real shape.
fatal_findings.evidence: bus_esl.provenance=ANALYTICAL_FROM_ASSUMED_GEOMETRY and cold_plate.provenance=ANALYTICAL_FROM_ASSUMED_GEOMETRY; mesh_authenticity.residual_cuboid lists sic_inverter, hv_bus, hv_connector, pack_housing, pack_base, mcu_shelf as plain_cuboid with fix_route build_universal_scene._place_traction_drive_pack_layout; authenticity score 0.7273.
fatal_findings.fix: Replace all six cuboids with dimensioned CAD from real supplier data (module footprint, laminated bus layout, connector MPN), re-derive ESL and thermal models from the released geometry, and re-run mesh authenticity to 1.0 for principal parts.
fatal_findings.source_rule_hint: form-meshes.json sha256 0d52805d...; open_until bus_3D_inductance, supplier_terminal_geometry, supplier_module_datasheet

high_findings.claim: Bus ESL is unmeasured with a ±50% spread (4.15–9.9 nH around 6.39 nH) and no double-pulse evidence. At SiC di/dt of 5–10 A/ns the upper bound implies 50–100 V switching overshoot on the DC bus; margin to a 1200 V module on an ~800–900 V FE bus is unquantified.
high_findings.evidence: analytical_physics.bus_esl: measured=false, range_nh [4.15,9.9], open_until bus_3D_inductance, double_pulse_bus_ESL_measurement, supplier_terminal_geometry; double_pulse_bench also open.
high_findings.fix: Run double-pulse bench at rated bus voltage and current, extract loop ESL and overshoot, verify module voltage margin with gate-resistor trade, replace analytical ESL with measured value.

high_findings.claim: The workbook is live at cell level but starved at input level: 8 live inputs and 11 live-plan formulas against a 254-node physics tree and 2,370 formula cells, with status self-declared LIVE_WITH_UNVALIDATED_ANALYTICAL_INPUTS. 1,324 verdict cells therefore render judgements on assumptions, not data — GIGO with a live recalculation engine.
high_findings.evidence: excel.live_input_count=8, live_formula_count=11, workbook_formula_cells=2370, verdict_formula_cells=1324, status=LIVE_WITH_UNVALIDATED_ANALYTICAL_INPUTS; 101 open_until items confirm the input provenance gap.
high_findings.fix: Expand the live-input schema so every physics leaf traces to a named input cell with provenance tag (MEASURED/SUPPLIER/ASSUMED), lock assumed cells with visible flags, and add an independent recalculation check plus sensitivity sweep on the 8 inputs.

high_findings.claim: 30.6% of the disposition matrix is duplication: 103 of 337 classified paths are 'duplicate'. The 100% coverage headline is inflated by copies, and 'mapped' (201) is triage, not design completion; 33 paths remain openly unresolved.
high_findings.evidence: checklist_disposition.counts: mapped=201, duplicate=103, open=33; honesty note confirms disposition ≠ designed or validated.
high_findings.fix: De-duplicate the matrix, re-baseline coverage against unique requirement IDs, and publish the 33 open paths as a named gap list with owners and closing artefacts.

high_findings.claim: No mass budget, mass roll-up or CG statement exists anywhere in the digest, and every structural validation (structural_FEA, carrier_FEA, joint_FEA, thermomechanical_FEA, GD&T stack, datum scheme) is open. For a front-axle FE installation, mass and packaging are first-order; the pack is silent.
high_findings.evidence: open_until includes structural_FEA, carrier_FEA, joint_FEA, thermomechanical_FEA, GD&T_stack, datum_scheme, bearing_stack_tolerance; no mass artefact in source_hashes.
high_findings.fix: Produce a component-level mass roll-up with tolerance, CG and inertia statement, structural FEA against race load cases, and a released datum/GD&T scheme.

high_findings.claim: No power-flow artefact exists: source (DC bus), sink (machine phases), regen direction, and loss split between inverter and machine are nowhere evidenced. The single 4,318 W heat load, if taken at a ~250 kW front-axle operating point, implies ~98.3% combined efficiency — an unverified best-case point presented without a loss map.
high_findings.evidence: analytical_physics.cold_plate.heat_load_w=4318 is the only energy-flow number in the digest; FEA_core_loss, double_pulse_bench, dyno and calibration all open; no efficiency map artefact.
high_findings.fix: Publish a full operating-map loss model (inverter + machine, drive and regen) anchored to double-pulse and core-loss FEA, then dyno-correlate; state DC bus voltage, phase current and power factor at each mapped point.
